registryEvidence: A first-party Chuzhou government/party portal article sourced from the Chuzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau documents the Chuzhou Real Estate Registration Center's local registration service, online no-face-to-face handling and registration-system work. An official Chuzhou government service document identifies the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the responsible unit for real-estate registration certificate/e-certificate services. This establishes local custodial evidence, not open parcel geometry access.
sourceScope: Chuzhou prefecture-level city, Anhui, China; local registration custodian and public service/procedure evidence were inspected. Anonymous citywide parcel geometry coverage was not established.
